title: Load a metadata bundle
responsibility: Load or reuse one pinned metadata bundle into the authorized source context.

inputs.name: hubMetadata.context
inputs.description: Authorized source context with repository, pinned commit, tree entries, source adapter and cache identity.

outputs.name: hubMetadata
outputs.description: Returns nothing after populating context.metadata; concurrent calls share metadataPending. Does nothing when metadata exists or the adapter lacks rawMany. Invalid cache bundles are deleted and refetched, and failed loads clear the pending promise.
